note: satb-s0: ts3native 0.36.125 (asi.satb1, docs/206 §7, ledger §399): docs/206 S0 probe on BP and IP = mono-cost13's Mode R config + [AutShadow] Satb=1 (probe: after each job, the sim's stores, first-written words, pages, loads and IC/runtime writer events are counted for one worker-job length of the next tick, the time a concurrent job would need the log; the worker still runs only in the window with WindowWaitUs, no concurrency). Goal: the docs/206 §5 gate. Read with node tools/harness/mono-cost-report.ts --tag satb-s0: the 'Satb probe per job span' and 'Satb barrier at go-live' lines: PASS = <= 3 ms/s and <= 20k words a job; STOP = > 5 ms/s or > 4 MB log (docs/206 §5: then no Satb=2 queue). Correctness unchanged from mono-cost13 (A1-A3 0). 2 x 10 min, ~30 min. Can run after mono-cost13 or instead of it (same keys + Satb).

jobs.note: 1/2 Satb probe (S0) on 0.36.125 (docs/206 §7). PASS = 0 crashes, no freeze; the mono-cost13 checks (A1-A3 0, listMissed 0, workExc 0, refExc 0, finishExc 0); -native.json autshadow v15: satbMode 1, satbSpans > 0, satbJobSpans > 0, satbOverflow 0 (a span that filled 65,534 words is itself the stop rule), satbWaits 0 (probe never waits).
